name: Name
delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this planned task?
dangerous_confirm_desc: Task [{{name}}] contains destructive operations (mirror / delete_source / delete). This may permanently delete files. Are you sure you want to run it?
dangerous_tip: This action can permanently delete files. Use "Dry Run" first; a real run asks for confirmation.

webhook.name: HTTP Request (Webhook)
webhook.desc: Send an HTTP request to a URL, e.g. to notify an external service.
webhook.params:
url (required): target URL
method: GET (default) | POST | PUT | DELETE
body: raw request body, e.g. a JSON string for POST
headers: extra headers, e.g. {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
timeout: timeout in seconds, default 30

backup.name: Backup
backup.desc: Incrementally back up the chosen source folder - including every subfolder and file inside it - into a same-named folder under the target. Re-runs only copy new or changed files.
backup.params:
source (required): the folder to back up, e.g. /myDrive/Movies
target (required): the backup root; the source folder is recreated inside it, e.g. /backup stores files as /backup/Movies/...
mode: copy = additive only (default) | mirror = also delete target files missing from source (dangerous)
rules.completion.action: none/keep_source = keep source (default) | delete_source = delete source after a successful copy (dangerous)
rules.deletion.action: keep = keep extra target files (default) | delete = delete extra target files (dangerous)
rules.replacement.action: skip = skip if the target file exists (default) | overwrite = overwrite
rules.filters.include / exclude: filter arrays, see the note below

traverse.name: Traverse (visit)
traverse.desc: Walk every folder under a path and load its listings/metadata. No files are downloaded or changed - it only visits, useful for warming up a storage's cache.
traverse.params:
path (required): the root folder to traverse, e.g. /myDrive/Movies
depth: how many folder levels to descend; 0 = unlimited (all subfolders), 1 = the path itself only, 2 = the path plus its immediate subfolders

filters_tip: Filter examples: {"type":"extension","value":"mkv,mp4"} keeps only those extensions; {"type":"size","value":"10MB","size_op":"min"} keeps files larger than 10MB; {"type":"regex","value":"^\\..*"} matches dotfiles — put it in "exclude" to skip them. Put a rule in "include" to allow-list, in "exclude" to block (exclude always wins).
params_visual_tip: Click a path input to open the folder tree; the selection is written into the JSON below. You can still edit the JSON directly.
webhook_tip: A webhook is simply "OpenList calls a URL on schedule". Fill in the URL and the task sends one HTTP request to it (GET by default) every time it fires — used to notify another system, trigger an external script or push a message. Note: OpenList SENDS the request, it does not receive anything.

completion.title: Completion rule
completion.tip: What to do with source files after a successful backup

replacement.title: Replacement rule
replacement.tip: When the target file already exists

deletion.title: Deletion rule
deletion.tip: Target files that no longer exist in the source

filters.title: Filter rules
filters.tip: Include = allow-list (anything unmatched is skipped). Exclude = block-list (anything matched is skipped). Exclude always wins.
filters.empty: No rules - every file is backed up
